entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: Angel of Innistrad, leader of the Flight of Goldnight and Avacyn's confidante, eldrazified by Emrakul and slain by her own sister.

entities.name: Flight of Goldnight
entities.description: Battle-oriented angel flight associated with the sun that oversees cathar training.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: Angel sister of Gisela, merged with her into Brisela.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel sister who was intimidated by Avacyn's group and killed Brisela.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose disappearance despaired Gisela; once corrupted she sought to wipe out humanity.

entities.name: Brisela
entities.description: Horrific amalgamation of Bruna and Gisela that enforced Emrakul's will.

entities.name: Feast of Goldnight
entities.description: Holiest human day, when the sun does not set for two days.

events.summary: Corrupted Avacyn, Gisela and Bruna visit Sigarda's home to intimidate her into joining their crusade to wipe out humanity.
events.quote: She, Avacyn and Bruna showed up at Sigarda's home, trying to intimidate her into joining their crusade.

events.summary: After Avacyn's death, Nahiri summons Emrakul, mutating Bruna and Gisela into Brisela.
events.quote: This resulted in Bruna and Gisela being mutated into a horrific amalgamation Brisela that enforced Emrakul's will.

relations.quote: Gisela, Bruna , Sigarda and Liesa are described as sisters and are older than Avacyn .
She was the leader of the Flight of Goldnight .
Of all the angels, Gisela is closest to Avacyn, being her confidante
